paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -3.42% on average, with FTSE 100 strongest (-1.82%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-7.70%). Brent crude changed -5.25% to 88.25. Gold changed -6.28% to 3,621.5. Bitcoin changed -3.27% to 59,875.7383. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.912%, a relative move of -3.74%. Among the firms tracked, Freeport-McMoRan (-14.27%) and Newmont (-10.13%) moved the most.
